assumptions: Vrooli Memory and Source Ledger are reachable for live operations.
Caller supplies scope and evidence; no scope provisioning occurs here.
invariants: The envelope is printed exactly once on every path.
No inference, direct storage, polling, or in-program retry.

signals.task_outcome: Unchanged caller task outcome, independent of capture.
signals.capture_status: complete or capture_failed; pending exists only before report.
signals.entry_id: Acknowledged attempt receipt entry ID, or null.
signals.existing: Whether Memory acknowledged an existing identical attempt.
signals.observations: Acknowledged observation receipts: entry_id, existing, observation_id.
signals.retry_inputs: Exact scope/attempt/observations supplied to writes; reuse unchanged, persist in caller outbox if needed.

outputs.evidence: Bounded Memory entry IDs from reads or acknowledged writes.

name: vrooli-memory.finish-attempt
purpose: Record a typed immutable attempt and bounded observations, returning acknowledged receipts and exact retry inputs while keeping task outcome separate from capture failure.

scope.description: Explicit provisioned Memory scope; no ambient default.

attempt.description: Snake-case Memory Attempt; deterministic attempt_id filled only if omitted.

attempts.description: Optional parent-first attempt tree. Each child names parent_attempt_id and step_name.

observations.description: At most 10 snake-case Observations; IDs filled if omitted, timestamps/provenance explicit.

memory.writes_when: Only after every input validates; at most one record and ten observes, stopping on first failure.

fixtures.note: Local validation rejection; never mutates live Memory.
